segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The objective was straightforward: get the round fired on schedule, keep fragmentation good enough for the mill, and stay inside our PPV limits near the shaft.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This states operational objectives and constraints without expressing a hidden bias mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Mostly time and track record. That pattern's fired dozens of rounds in similar ground without a hiccup, so redesigning burden and spacing for a fault trace that geology themselves called minor felt like it would cost us a day we didn't have.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant retains the established burden-and-spacing pattern despite new fault-trace information, relying on its historical track record.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I've used full ANFO columns in ground that looked rougher than this and it worked out fine, so I told the crew we'd run it as planned.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant overrides the technician's decking and emulsion recommendation based on generalized prior experience without rechecking current hole data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I compared the fragmentation trade-off against the vibration risk directly and went with the longer sequence on the shaft-facing side.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The decision explicitly weighs current PPV data against fragmentation trade-offs and has no hidden manifest instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We had current numbers right in front of us — actual PPV readings, not just a general sense of things.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a data-based explanation for why the timing decision felt resolved and contains no hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It reminded me a lot of a panel I worked years ago at a different site — same kind of localized fault, same overbreak signature. There, the fix was tightening the pattern and adjusting timing specifically through that corridor, and it worked well. So that's what I recommended here.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant attributes the outcome to a remembered prior-mine pattern and recommends its fix without first incorporating current instrumentation.
